row.team_price_text: Foundations: Contact Sales (fixed monthly platform fee plus transaction fees, unlimited users)
row.evidence: Spendesk's Okta SSO guide says "No. User auto-provisioning (SCIM) is not supported. Invite users to Spendesk first."
row.notes: Spendesk documents that SCIM and JIT are not supported with Okta, OneLogin or Azure AD; users must be invited (or bulk-imported by file) first. Quote-based pricing: the pricing page shows a 'Foundations' base package (Request a free quote) with a fixed monthly platform fee plus transaction fees and unlimited users. SAML SSO: the login article says Premium only, the Okta/OneLogin guide says Growth and Premium or a paid add-on, and the pricing page lists SSO/SAML in Foundations (see conflicts). Vendor-run HRIS sync (Personio, BambooHR, HiBob, Workday, Deel, PayFit, Lucca) creates, updates and archives members on Scale and Premium plans. The public API (on request) has read-only GET /v1/users and /v1/users/{id}.

plans.name: Foundations
plans.notes: Base package on the pricing page; fixed monthly fee plus variable transaction fees, unlimited users. Pricing page lists 'Set up SSO, SAML' but help articles gate SAML to Premium (or Growth/add-on). Help centre also names Growth, Scale and Premium plans that the pricing page does not show.

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: Named in help articles only; SAML SSO and HR tool sync.

deprovision.notes: No SCIM. Manual member deletion deactivates the member's cards and login and lets subscriptions be transferred (c17).

limitations.text: SCIM and JIT provisioning are not supported with Okta, OneLogin or Azure AD; every user must be invited first.

endpoints.purpose: Exchange API key for a 60-minute access token

webhooks_user_events.notes: Experimental webhooks cover payables and settlements only.

rate_limits.text: 1,000 requests per minute per company and credential

limitations.text: API access is requested through the Spendesk representative; user endpoints in the reference are read-only.

entra.notes: Not in the Entra gallery; SAML works via a non-gallery app.

google.notes: 'Google authentication' sign-in is social login, not SAML.

onelogin.notes: From Spendesk's own Okta/OneLogin guide; OneLogin catalogue not checked.

fallbacks.other_sync: Native HR tool sync (Personio, BambooHR, HiBob, Workday, Deel, PayFit, Lucca) creates, updates and archives members on Scale and Premium plans
fallbacks.notes: Bulk member import is by file upload (template spreadsheet), not CSV specifically.
